decisions.what: Created app/page.tsx from scratch instead of modifying an existing file
decisions.why: The spec listed the operation as 'modify' but app/page.tsx did not exist in the repository (Next.js app router entry was missing). Created a minimal HomePage that hosts the PortfolioGallery under an 'Our Work' section with pixel-aesthetic styling and grid-pattern background, matching the spec.

decisions.what: Used matrix-black and cyber-green Tailwind color tokens throughout portfolio components
decisions.why: The existing OptimizedImage component and project styling already reference bg-matrix-black and text-cyber-green, confirming these are the established brand tokens for the codebase.

decisions.what: Included framer-motion, react-focus-lock, and react-dom createPortal imports without installing them
decisions.why: Task specs explicitly require Framer Motion for animations, react-focus-lock for modal accessibility, and React Portal for modal rendering. These are assumed to be part of the Next.js/React application dependency graph as instructed by the specs.

decisions.what: Implemented IntersectionObserver-based lazy rendering inside PortfolioGallery
decisions.why: Spec 006 required intersection observer for lazy rendering cards below the fold; the first three cards render immediately and remaining cards mount when they enter the viewport with a 200px rootMargin.

decisions.what: Left the .gitkeep file empty and did not create an accompanying README.md
decisions.why: Spec 008 target file is only the .gitkeep; the prompt's global rules forbid creating .md files, so the README described in the spec text was omitted in favor of following the explicit no-markdown constraint.
